Generate a cellpal colour palette

Source: R/cellpal.R
cellpal.Rd

Generate categorical or continuous palettes for single-cell, transcriptomic, and general ggplot2 visualizations.

cellpal(
  palette = "base",
  n = NULL,
  type = c("discrete", "continuous"),
  reverse = FALSE,
  alpha = 1
)

Arguments

palette

Character or unquoted palette name.

n

Number of colours to return. By default, returns the original palette length.

type

Palette type: "discrete" or "continuous".

reverse

Logical. Reverse the palette.

alpha

Numeric transparency between 0 and 1.

direction

Integer, either 1 or -1. An alternative to reverse.

Value

A character vector of hexadecimal colours with class "cellpal".

Examples

cellpal(nature)
#> Error: object 'nature' not found
cellpal("jama", n = 3)
#> <cellpal: jama>
#> 1: #374E55FF
#> 2: #DF8F44FF
#> 3: #00A1D5FF
#> 
cellpal(base, n = 20)
#> Error: object 'base' not found
cellpal(heatmap_nature, n = 100, type = "continuous")
#> Error: object 'heatmap_nature' not found
